product_title: Royal Peacock & Krishna Pearl Toran (38 inches)
product_description: Bring divine charm to your entrance with this beautifully handcrafted toran, featuring vibrant peacock motifs, Lord Krishna embellishment, decorative elephants, intricate golden detailing, and elegant pearl hangings. Perfect for Diwali, Janmashtami, pooja rooms, weddings, and traditional home décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle decorative elements and pearl hangings carefully.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
